targetTexts.1: Then the whole council rose and led Jesus away to Pilate.
targetTexts.2: And they began to accuse Him, saying, “We found this man subverting our nation, forbidding payment of taxes to Caesar, and proclaiming Himself to be Christ, a King.”
targetTexts.3: So Pilate asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
targetTexts.4: Then Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”
targetTexts.5: But they kept insisting, “He stirs up the people all over Judea with His teaching. He began in Galilee and has come all the way here.”
targetTexts.6: When Pilate heard this, he asked if the man was a Galilean.
targetTexts.7: And learning that Jesus was under Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, who himself was in Jerusalem at that time.
targetTexts.8: When Herod saw Jesus, he was greatly pleased. He had wanted to see Him for a long time, because he had heard about Him and was hoping to see Him perform a miracle.
targetTexts.9: Herod questioned Jesus at great length, but He gave no answer.
targetTexts.10: Meanwhile, the chief priests and scribes stood there, vehemently accusing Him.
targetTexts.11: And even Herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked Him. Dressing Him in a fine robe, they sent Him back to Pilate.
targetTexts.12: That day Herod and Pilate became friends; before this time they had been enemies.
targetTexts.13: Then Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
targetTexts.14: and said to them, “You brought me this man as one who was inciting the people to rebellion. I have examined Him here in your presence and found Him not guilty of your charges against Him.
targetTexts.15: Neither has Herod, for he sent Him back to us. As you can see, He has done nothing deserving of death.
targetTexts.16: Therefore I will punish Him and release Him.”
targetTexts.18: But they all cried out in unison: “Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!”
targetTexts.19: (Barabbas had been imprisoned for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)
targetTexts.20: Wanting to release Jesus, Pilate addressed them again,
targetTexts.21: but they kept shouting, “Crucify Him! Crucify Him!”
targetTexts.22: A third time he said to them, “What evil has this man done? I have found in Him no offense worthy of death. So after I punish Him, I will release Him.”
targetTexts.23: But they were insistent, demanding with loud voices for Jesus to be crucified. And their clamor prevailed.
targetTexts.24: So Pilate sentenced that their demand be met.
targetTexts.25: As they had requested, he released the one imprisoned for insurrection and murder, and he handed Jesus over to their will.
targetTexts.26: As the soldiers led Him away, they seized Simon of Cyrene on his way in from the country, and they put the cross on him to carry behind Jesus.
targetTexts.27: A great number of people followed Him, including women who kept mourning and wailing for Him.
targetTexts.28: But Jesus turned to them and said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
targetTexts.29: Look, the days are coming when people will say, ‘Blessed are the barren women, the wombs that never bore, and breasts that never nursed!’
targetTexts.30: At that time ‘they will say to the mountains, “Fall on us!” and to the hills, “Cover us!”’
targetTexts.31: For if men do these things while the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?”
targetTexts.32: Two others, who were criminals, were also led away to be executed with Jesus.
targetTexts.33: When they came to the place called The Skull, they crucified Him there, along with the criminals, one on His right and the other on His left.
targetTexts.34: Then Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.” And they divided up His garments by casting lots.
targetTexts.35: The people stood watching, and the rulers sneered at Him, saying, “He saved others; let Him save Himself if He is the Christ of God, the Chosen One.”
targetTexts.36: The soldiers also mocked Him and came up to offer Him sour wine.
targetTexts.37: “If You are the King of the Jews,” they said, “save Yourself!”
targetTexts.38: Above Him was posted an inscription: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
targetTexts.39: One of the criminals who hung there heaped abuse on Him. “Are You not the Christ?” he said. “Save Yourself and us!”
targetTexts.40: But the other one rebuked him, saying, “Do you not even fear God, since you are under the same judgment?
targetTexts.41: We are punished justly, for we are receiving what our actions deserve. But this man has done nothing wrong.”
targetTexts.42: Then he said, “Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom!”
targetTexts.43: And Jesus said to him, “Truly I tell you, today you will be with Me in Paradise.”
targetTexts.44: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over all the land until the ninth hour.
targetTexts.45: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn down the middle.
targetTexts.46: Then Jesus called out in a loud voice, “Father, into Your hands I commit My Spirit.” And when He had said this, He breathed His last.
targetTexts.47: When the centurion saw what had happened, he gave glory to God, saying, “Surely this was a righteous man.”
targetTexts.48: And when all the people who had gathered for this spectacle saw what had happened, they returned home beating their breasts.
targetTexts.49: But all those who knew Jesus, including the women who had followed Him from Galilee, stood at a distance watching these things.
targetTexts.50: Now there was a Council member named Joseph, a good and righteous man,
targetTexts.51: who had not consented to their decision or action. He was from the Judean town of Arimathea and was waiting for the kingdom of God.
targetTexts.52: He went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus.
targetTexts.53: Then he took it down, wrapped it in a linen cloth, and placed it in a tomb cut into the rock, where no one had yet been laid.
targetTexts.54: It was Preparation Day, and the Sabbath was beginning.
targetTexts.55: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed, and they saw the tomb and how His body was placed.
targetTexts.56: Then they returned to prepare spices and perfumes. And they rested on the Sabbath, according to the commandment.
